findings.text: sweep_stale_arm_trees re-implements the sweep loop that sweep_abandoned_base_trees (same module, :2602) already owns: iterate the scratch root's children by prefix, skip any a live process holds via _scratch_process_holders, compute tree_size_bytes, rmtree, print and record the removal. The new function adds an age bound and a node field but does not wrap or parameterise the existing owner, so the two loops must be kept in step by hand. Section s71 of the same plan already records that no duplicate sweep helper should remain; this is that duplicate. Non-blocking because both loops are individually correct and unit-tested.

sweep_this_node_arm_trees has no caller anywhere in reckon/ or tests/; the production sweep paths call sweep_stale_arm_trees directly (via arm_sweep_command -> sweep_arm_trees_entry at :2797, and via _partition_runner at :1644). It is dead code that the next reader must open and dismiss. Section s71 names this unused helper as its own to remove. Non-blocking.

The sweep is injected at three places -- the generated measurement-job script (submit_measurement, :244), the per-arm script (_partition_runner, :1644) and the delayed sweep (_submit_delayed_sweep, :1463) -- but tests/test_a_landing_arm_leaves_no_tree.py only exercises sweep_stale_arm_trees and arm_sweep_command directly. No test asserts that any of the three insertion points actually emits the sweep command, so deleting the sweep line from any of them leaves the suite green. This is a durability gap in the gained change; section s71 records the same gap and owns the three wiring tests. Non-blocking because the functions themselves are guarded and the runtime insertion is visible in the generated script.

The fragment states the importer arms ran 'on 98dci4-clu-3144 with 18 GB free in its temporary space, which each log records beside its own figures'. The two logs it cites record 19G (gate-importer-base.log) and 17G (gate-importer-head.log); 18G is the figure in gate-suite-base.log, which the sentence is not about. A reader reconciling the claim against the importer logs it names finds a value neither shows. Non-blocking: the node and the environment claim (node with space) are true and the gate figures in the same sentence reconcile exactly with the logs.
